properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Front Door: Audit HTTP to HTTPS Redirect
properties.description: Audits that Azure Front Door routes are configured to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS. FedRAMP High requires transmission confidentiality and integrity (SC-8) for all web traffic. HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect ensures clients are automatically redirected to encrypted connections.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance when HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect is not configured. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
